feeds.title: TortsProf
feeds.description: TortsProf is a member of the Law Professor Blogs Network that contains information about Tort Law. Law Professor Blogs is the nation's only network of legal blogs edited primarily by law professors. Editors include leading scholars and educators who are committed to providing the web source of legal news & information for law practitioners, government, and nonprofit lawyers.

feeds.title: Day on Torts
feeds.description: Day on Torts blog provides information on personal injury and business litigation law in Tennessee. We are a law firm representing clients in personal injury and wrongful death claims. Our attorneys have dedicated themselves to helping injury victims and their families in and around Tennessee.

feeds.title: Undergraduate Laws Blog » Tort
feeds.description: Read stories, news, and updates on tort law from our team and our students. At the University of London, students can study for an LLB degree of international standing as independent learners. The Undergraduate Laws are committed to providing a wealth of resources, offering expert guidance in law, developing 'transferable' intellectual skills, and enabling you to develop critical awareness.

feeds.title: Jotwell » Torts
feeds.description: The Jotwell journal is produced by a very large team of volunteers, and provides pointers to the best new tort law-related scholarship by creating a space where legal academics can go to identify, celebrate, and discuss the best new scholarship relevant to the law.

feeds.title: Moll Law Group Blog
feeds.description: Read about personal injury and mass Tort Law blog published by Moll Law Group. At Moll Law Group, with our injury lawyers, we are helping injured victims get the compensation they deserve. With the goal of fighting for our clients and keeping consumers safe, we have created a network of resources that provide life-saving and injury prevention information to everyone.

feeds.title: Cusimano, Roberts, Mills & Knowlton Blog
feeds.description: Read stories, news, and updates on tort law written on Alabama Tort Law Blog. Alabama is here for you to serve with a greater quality of legal services. Our attorneys have distinguished themselves in special areas such as trial techniques, jury attitudes, and tort law. We provide clients with a complete team approach where they can rest assured they have an unparalleled legal team in their corner.

feeds.title: Rabbi Lawyer Blog
feeds.description: Michael Rubinstein is the founder of the Law Office of Michael E. Rubinstein, a personal injury practice located in Los Angeles. His compassionate and creative approach to resolving cases has enabled him to successfully resolve cases involving pedestrians struck by automobiles, automobile accidents, bicycle accidents, premises liability (slip and fall), and dog bites.

feeds.title: UK Law Weekly » Tort
feeds.description: Find Tort law news and other legal updates from the UK provided in UK Law Weekly's database. Marcus Cleaver is the host of the UK Law Weekly website. He produces video lectures and provides free ebooks on a range of subjects for students studying law.

feeds.title: Mass Tort News
feeds.description: Mass Tort News presents real-time webcasts on emerging & mass tort litigation featuring the nation's most recognized and respected attorneys. We offer industry leaders insight into all aspects of successful mass tort practice. We also deliver unique access and guidance in other commercial practice areas.

feeds.title: The Mass Tort Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Mass Tort Institute is dedicated to providing education, training, and networking opportunities for those advocating on behalf of mass tort victims. Our mission is to equip legal professionals with the tools they need to successfully resolve legal claims against some of the largest corporations in the world.

feeds.title: Mass Torts Made Perfect
feeds.description: Mass Torts Made Perfect is a bi-annual conference held in the spring and fall of each year in Las Vegas. The event was created with the idea of convening select attorneys involved in the practice of mass torts pharmaceutical litigation in an effort to share ideas and resources in combating multi-national corporate defendants.

feeds.title: Tort Talk
feeds.description: Hi, I am Daniel E. Cummins, an AV-Rated civil litigator, handling personal injury civil litigation matters all across Northeastern Pennsylvania. I've created this Tort Talk blog with the insight of serving as a mediator. My blog provides continuing updates on important cases and trends in Pennsylvania civil litigation law.
